$comment: Party's and Relationship's declarations for stores on the kernel (lib/stores.js). A store is a node of the store kind (owner Party), known by its store id. The places it serves are a relationship of their own (owner Relationship): in the `serves` hierarchy the store sits under every place it serves — a country, a subdivision, a city, a planet, any mix — each with its own time window, so a store serves a set of places rather than embedding one country and region. Its jurisdiction (where it is registered, which answers its tax and its default currency and locale) is a Party setting at the store's node naming one of the places it serves. A store is never invented a place: a new store's jurisdiction is the one it is created with, else the platform's provisioning policy.
